title: Interesting Podcast that Mentions Mall World
content: I recently listened to [this episode](https://rss.com/podcasts/postreality/1977206/) of a podcast that mentioned Mall World. I think it was an interesting discussion that kind of covered the ideas of what shared dreaming is, and they touched on the GATE program at the end which I find especially interesting considering I was in the Gifted program in 4th grade and I've been a lifelong Mall World dreamer. Do you guys know of any other podcasts that mention Mall World?
